name: [🌭] Be A Food
desc:
A unique combination of Agar.io and RNG gameplay

🥜 Play as different foods. Eat things to get bigger 🥜
🍖 Eat other players as you try to become the biggest!
🍣 Unlock new foods as you play
🍀 Increase your luck to roll rare and OP foods! 🍨
🛒 Grow your food collection for permanent boosts and rewards!
